text:
tia_engineer: FYI got a report: customer 'beta-search' hits high latency and occasional 413s when sending large embedding batches (~100 inputs) where many items are small (dim 128) but some are 2048. They use mixed batch.

olivia_support: Customer pasted a sample: ~95 inputs, total payload 2.8MB, varied dims. They see 413 ~20% of calls and long tail latency otherwise.

nate_sre: Two immediate suspects: 1) our per-tenant max_vectors limit (we enforce soft quota per-second), 2) router path that splits by bytes not by vectors leading to inefficient batching.

maya_prod: We recently tightened a per-route byte budget in the router to reduce OOMs on GPU shards. That policy doesn't account for mixed-dim inefficiency: a few 2048 dims force wide allocation.

tia_engineer: Right. Our embedding runtime allocs based on max(seq_len, dim) rounding and then pads to nearest 64 for kernel choice. A few heavy dims blow up memory.

olivia_support: Customer wants guidance: should they pre-split by dim? Are we going to support automatic split-by-dim on ingress?

maya_prod: Current behaviour: ingress tries a simple splitter that chunks by total bytes; it does not inspect per-item dim. We avoided dim-aware splitting to keep estimator cheap.

nate_sre: Proposal: add a lightweight preflight that samples first N items to compute dim histogram and, if variance>threshold, prefer split-by-dim. That would avoid sending heavy vectors to the same shard as many small ones.

tia_engineer: Sampling and histograming is cheap (O(N) small). But it will add latency to every request unless we make it optional (header opt-in) or cache split plans for the client via console hints.

maya_prod: Alternatively we could offer "auto-split=dim-aware" flag per-route (console toggle) for customers who need it. Default remains byte-based splitter to keep ingress cheap.

olivia_support: From support side, an SDK helper to produce a split plan client-side would be helpful. We can put JS/Python helpers in DevEx.

devex-bot: Note: DEVEX-320 exists for x-embed-units docs. We can extend it to include split-by-dim examples.

tia_engineer: Telemetry ask: add a metric embed_split_mode with values {byte,dim,client} and a counter for auto-split decisions. We need to know how often dim-aware would kick in and how effective it is.

nate_sre: Also instrument per-request "max_dim" and "median_dim" tags (histogram) so we can correlate latency/413 with dim skew.

maya_prod: UX: Console route diagnostics could surface a "recommended split" button that runs the sampler on a pasted payload and shows a plan. This avoids enabling dim-aware globally.

tia_engineer: Implementation path: 1) quick telemetry + sampling instrumentation (1 sprint), 2) SDK split helpers and console "recommend" (2 sprints), 3) optional server-side dim-aware splitter behind feature flag (3+ sprints).

olivia_support: For immediate customer workaround, we told them to split payload by max vectors 20 or by dim groups. They confirmed improvement.

maya_prod: About status codes: current fast-fail returns 413 when estimated work > hard limit. We debated 429 previously. Still think 413 is confusing to customers when the HTTP body is not actually too large. Consider a future change to 429 with explicit reason string.

nate_sre: Agreed but be conservative: changing code will affect monitoring and alerts. Add a response field cause="estimate" and reason="dim-skew" before flipping status.

tia_engineer: I'll open two tickets: PLAT-772 (telemetry + sampler) and PLAT-773 (SDK split helpers + console recommend). Also will adjust ingress to attach cause tags in rejection body.

devex-bot: Tickets created: PLAT-772, PLAT-773.

olivia_support: Noted. I'll add KB article with sample split script and link to SDK helpers once available.

maya_prod: One more: routing policy - consider a "soft_shard_preference" for tenants that prefer latency over cost. For high variance workloads, dedicate shards with wider memory to avoid fragmentation. We'll discuss capacity impact in next infra triage.

nate_sre: Sounds good. For now I'll add monitoring alert to surface rising 413s correlated with median_dim>512. Need dashboards.

tia_engineer: I'll add the telemetry metrics and a Grafana panel for dim skew vs 413 rate.

olivia_support: Customer follow-up scheduled. They asked if console could suggest "request Dedicated" - please add that to recommended_action options in UI mockups.

maya_prod: Will include recommended_action: [split-by-dim, set-x-embed-units, request-dedicated] in the console mock.

nate_sre: Closing action items: PLAT-772 (telemetry + sampler), PLAT-773 (SDK + console), MON-909 (dashboards & alerts), INF-201 (dedicated-shard feasibility).

olivia_support: Thanks all — keeping thread open for progress updates.
